# post in

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:postIn`](gmeow-postIn.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/postIn>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The organization a post belongs to. Functional — a post concerns exactly one organization.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Post`](../classes/gmeow-Post.md) -> [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:postIn`](gmeow-postIn.md) from [`gmeow:Post`](../classes/gmeow-Post.md) to [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Post`](../classes/gmeow-Post.md) to the one organization whose seat it is.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a person (a post's organization is not its incumbent) and avoid more than one organization per post — it is functional; a seat that spans organizations is a different [`Post`](../classes/gmeow-Post.md) in each.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:postIn`](gmeow-postIn.md) once per [`gmeow:Post`](../classes/gmeow-Post.md) (functional) to the [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md), pairing it with [`gmeow:hasRole`](gmeow-hasRole.md); an EL restriction already guarantees every [`Post`](../classes/gmeow-Post.md) mediates at least one organization.

### Examples
